title: Will Morgan Wallen have above 7.5M daily views at any point during October 2026?
rules: If Morgan Wallen has above 7.5M Global views on YouTube at any point during October 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
View counts may vary by location. This market will resolve using values displayed from a New York IP address.

Global daily views can be accessed through YouTube Charts by searching for the artist and selecting “Global” as the location.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by YouTube. Any references to YouTube charts or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between YouTube and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Kworb shows Morgan Wallen's official-channel videos averaging about 2.6M views a day. Adding audio-only Topic tracks and fan uploads likely puts his YouTube Charts global total around 6.5–8M a day, close to the 7.5M line. The market needs only one day above 7.5M in October, which helps, but the tour has ended, the album is more than a year old and I found no confirmed October release, so I lean slightly toward NO. I couldn't check the actual YouTube Charts number, so confidence is low.
blind.falsifier: YouTube Charts showing Wallen's global daily views already regularly above 7.5M, or a new single or album dropping in October 2026 that pushes a single day above 7.5M.

final.reasoning: The low price late in October suggests the 7.5M mark hasn't been hit yet, with only about nine days left. My 40% rested on a guessed multiplier, so I'm deferring to the market. With a wide spread and no clear edge, I'm passing.
